correctness.rationale: The defining identity gives k*sigma(n)=(k+1)(n+1)-2, which is 2 modulo 4 for odd k,n. Thus v2(sigma(n))=1. Multiplicativity gives exactly one odd prime exponent, and LTE applied to its prime-power sigma factor forces both the distinguished prime and exponent to be 1 modulo 4.
